about: Does the proposed three-way split of python-conventions route requests correctly, and does it
collide with the two skills already flagged as living inside its trigger region?
python-conventions is 1302 chars against a 1024 spec cap. Trimming is ruled out - it would
delete trigger vocabulary - and published measurement says comprehensive skills score below
having no skill at all while detailed ones score well above, so over-scoped is the likelier
reading. This suite is the check that has to pass before the split is worth doing.
Three things it has to show: each piece wins its own requests; the pieces do not steal from
each other; and neither invoke-task-conventions nor db-defaults loses ground, since the whole
reason python-conventions was suspected of shadowing them was its breadth.
